videos.caption: 🌼 Aquí tienes una receta deliciosa y fácil de tarta de piña sin horno, perfecta para  cuando no quieres encender el horno. --- 🍍 Tarta de Piña sin Horno 🕒 Tiempo total Preparación: 25 minutos Reposo en nevera: 4 horas (mínimo) 🍽️ Rinde para 8 a 10 porciones --- 🧂 Ingredientes Base: 200 g de galletas tipo María o Digestive 100 g de mantequilla derretida Relleno: 1 lata grande de piña en almíbar (aprox. 500 g) 1 sobre de gelatina de piña (o neutra si prefieres menos sabor artificial) 200 ml del jugo (almíbar) de la piña 200 ml de agua caliente 200 ml de nata para montar (crema para batir) o crema de leche 200 g de queso crema (tipo Philadelphia) 3 cucharadas de azúcar (ajusta al gusto) Decoración (opcional): Rodajas de piña y cerezas en almíbar Coco rallado o virutas de chocolate blanco --- 👩‍🍳 Preparación paso a paso 1️⃣ Prepara la base 1. Tritura las galletas hasta que queden como polvo fino. 2. Mézclalas con la mantequilla derretida hasta obtener una masa arenosa. 3. Colócala en el fondo de un molde desmontable (22–24 cm) y presiona bien con una cuchara. 4. Mete el molde al refrigerador mientras preparas el relleno. 2️⃣ Prepara la mezcla de piña 1. Drena las rodajas de piña y guarda 200 ml del almíbar. 2. Disuelve el sobre de gelatina en 200 ml de agua caliente. 3. Añade el almíbar de piña y deja que temple un poco. 3️⃣ Prepara la crema 1. En un bol, bate el queso crema con el azúcar hasta que quede suave. 2. Añade la nata (o crema de leche) y mezcla bien. 3. Agrega la gelatina disuelta (ya templada, no caliente) y mezcla hasta integrar. 4. Incorpora trocitos pequeños de piña a la mezcla. 4️⃣ Monta la tarta 1. Vierte la mezcla sobre la base de galleta. 2. Alisa la superficie y lleva a la nevera por mínimo 4 horas (idealmente toda la noche). 5️⃣ Decora 1. Cuando esté firme, decora con rodajas de piña y cerezas. 2. Si quieres, espolvorea coco rallado o virutas de chocolate blanco. --- 💡 Consejos Puedes usar gelatina neutra y añadir esencia de piña o vainilla si prefieres un sabor más natural. Para una textura más ligera, sustituye el queso crema por yogur griego natural. Si la piña es muy ácida, prueba la mezcla antes de refrigerar y ajusta el azúcar. ---

I decided to double up on reel meals since I’m behind with editing… Loaded Chicken Twice Baked Potato!!! Nuff said. I wish y’all could taste through the screen omg. I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

videos.caption: SLOPPY JOE BUNS RECIPE BELOW Ingredients DOUGH 250 ml lukewarm milk (1 cup) 15 g honey (1 tbsp) 7 g instant yeast (1 tbsp) 1 large egg 45 g unsalted butter, room temperature (3 tbsp, 1/2 stick) 500 g all-purpose flour (4 cups) 8 g fine salt (1⅓ tsp) SLOPPY JOE FILLING 25 ml olive oil (2 tbsp) 600 g ground beef (1⅓ lb) 4 g fine salt (⅔ tsp) 3 g paprika (1 tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 3 g onion powder (1 tsp) 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 1.5 g black pepper (½ tsp) 100 g ketchup (6 tbsps) EXTRA cheese slices (American or cheddar) Big Mac-style burger sauce 1 egg, beaten Sesame seeds Instructions Prepare all the ingredients. In a large bowl, combine the lukewarm milk, honey and yeast. Stir well and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes. Add the egg and butter and mix well. Add the flour and salt. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper. Cook for 7-8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ketchup. Stir the ketchup into the beef until well combined. Let the filling cool completely before adding it to the dough. Deflate the risen dough and divide it into 9 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Roll each dough ball into a round sheet. Place a slice of cheese in the center of each disc, then top with some of the beef filling and a spoonful of burger sauce. Add extra cheese if you like. Fold the dough inwards and pinch it tightly closed. Place the buns seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 12-18 minutes, or until golden brown. #food #sloppyjoe #beef #cheese #tiktokfood

Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef.
